description: This file defines the FlowPartDisplayDriver class, which manages the display, editing, and updating of FlowPart content items within OrchardCore CMS. It handles rendering, content type validation, authorization, and content merging logic.

classes.name: FlowPartDisplayDriver
classes.description: A driver class for displaying, editing, and updating FlowPart content items in OrchardCore CMS.

methods.name: Display
methods.description: Renders the display view of a FlowPart, showing either content or an empty placeholder.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Returns the editor shape for editing a FlowPart.

methods.name: EditInternal
methods.description: Prepares the editor shape with validation and warning notifications for the FlowPart.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Handles the update process for a FlowPart, including content merging, authorization, and state management.

methods.name: GetContainedContentTypesAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the list of contained content types based on the FlowPart settings.

methods.name: AuthorizeAsync
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to perform an action on a content type or content item.
